title: The 22% Consultation Drag: Quantifying Unbilled Fee-Earner Leakage in Boutique Practices
summary: Empirical breakdown of how pre-consultation 6-gate deterministic triage recovers 6 to 10 hours per fee-earner per week.
body_html:
At a fully-loaded cost of £275 per hour, every uninstructed 45-minute consultation costs a boutique immigration practice both direct fee-earner capacity and opportunity cost on viable corporate and private matters.

Pre-Consultation Deterministic Filtering

By routing inbound web and voice enquiries through a 6-gate deterministic assessment prior to calendar booking, fee earners engage exclusively with structured, decision-ready dossiers.

title: UK Skilled Worker Visa 2026: The 6 Readiness Gates Before Booking a Legal Consultation
summary: A structured pre-consultation guide for Skilled Worker applicants and HR sponsors to verify salary thresholds, SOC codes, and Certificate of Sponsorship readiness.
body_html:
Over 22% of initial UK immigration consultations fail to progress to a formal instruction due to preventable gaps in sponsor readiness, salary threshold calculations, or unflagged immigration history.

Verifying Your 6 Core Gates First

Before committing to a paid legal consultation, applicants and HR sponsors can verify Route Fit, Sponsor Licence status, Immigration History, Fee Capacity, Jurisdiction, and Statutory Section 3C Urgency in under 3 minutes.

title: Why Propose-Only AI Sandboxes and Byte-Pinned Attestation Define 2026 SRA Compliance
summary: How UK immigration and regulated practices eliminate AI hallucination risk by separating deterministic state machines from LLM triage.
body_html:
As UK practices face heightened scrutiny under SRA Principles and UK GDPR Article 22, allowing probabilistic language models to directly mutate case states or approve client evidence introduces unacceptable regulatory exposure.

The Propose-Only Sandbox Architecture

In AirCounsel STRATA V5.0, language models operate strictly as propose-only assistants. Every Certificate of Sponsorship, bank statement, and identity document must pass deterministic inspection and receive a byte-pinned SHA-256 human practitioner attestation before promotion to trusted storage.
